Good care starts
with a clear plan.

All rates, minimum charges, travel and estimates include 19% VAT. VAT is never added again. Reserve is an optional planning allowance. Travel applies to each on-site service visit, even if visits might later be combined.

What is included in this planning estimate?

Base assumptions: accessible property, normal working hours and the selected scope only. Rates, minimums and condition adjustments are prototype assumptions, not verified Cyprus market prices or approved INONDA tariffs. Displayed rates reflect the selected property type and include 19% VAT.

Cleaning & gardening: routine labour and basic consumables assumed; specialist machinery, waste removal, tall trees and hazardous materials excluded. Cleaning area is capped to indoor size.

Renovation: the selected finish allowance and labour only. Structural changes, permits, surveys, major plumbing/electrical works, fixtures and unforeseen defects are excluded. A site survey and licensed professionals may be required.

Maintenance & handyman: inspection or labour allowance only; parts, repairs and specialist trades excluded. Management covers coordination and reporting only; third-party bills and rent collection are excluded.

Monthly cleaning or gardening uses the selected visit frequency. Weekly visits average 52 ÷ 12 per month. Monthly figures are ongoing costs; one-off work is separate. No duration or availability is promised.

Planning range, not a fixed quote.
Includes 19% VAT. Final scope needs assessment.

For jobs estimated at up to €1,000, the on-site quotation visit is free within 10 km of our office in Strovolos and costs €50 beyond 10 km. In Limassol, Larnaca, Agia Napa and Paphos, quotation visits for jobs up to €1,000 are charged; for work over €1,000, the quotation is included in the work. We assess, quote and take on only jobs of more than one day of work. Small repairs and jobs of a few minutes or hours are carried out only for customers with a maintenance contract.
